catalog.title: Seiko
catalog.note: Hattori (服部時計店) dealer catalogue of the mid-1950s: Seiko wristwatches (セイコー腕時計, scans 1–6) followed by Seikosha alarm clocks (精工舎の目覚時計 Nos. 910R–915R, scans 7–10) and wall clocks (精工舎の掛時計, 7吋二週間捲スリゲル Nos. 2701–2721, 2551, 2761, 2801 and the 1202/1691 トーマス dials, scans 11–18), which get no records. Each watch is printed as a list number with model name and size, e.g. No. 61 マーベル 14型, then one line per case/jewel/dial variant; ref = romanised model name + number (Marvel No.61, Unique No.68, Automatic No.59 for 自動巻), and the ladies' 5型 watches, which print no model name, are Seiko No.75 etc. Jewels as printed (石), set only when every variant has the same count; sizes (型) are in specs. Cases as printed: SS stainless, FGF / AGF gold-filled grades, EGP gold-plated, SP, BS, K18 solid gold. Dials: 金浮支 gold applied markers, 銀浮支 silver applied markers, 夜光 luminous, 磨字 polished markers. The catalogue prints no prices and no movement calibers.
catalog.method: Vision transcription of 250 DPI renders, Oct 2026, verified against caption crops at full resolution.
